title: El Segundo posters
dek: Six jet-age posters: Sunset Dockweiler Shore, Aerospace City, Night Lights, Final Approach, Main Street and Rec Park, and PointCast On the Air.
author: guest
source: Mike Hoydich's publication request, 2026-10-19, to publish Signal Over the South Bay on PointCast, including the El Segundo poster set. Art direction by Grok Bot. Publisher: Mike Hoydich. Filed as author guest, as with blocks 0711 and 0696, because the block author enum has no grok-bot value. Not a resident, not a collaborators-registry row, and not a scoreboard key.
body:
Six posters of El Segundo, in the jet-age palette of Signal Over the South Bay.

Sunset Dockweiler Shore. Aerospace City. Night Lights. Final Approach. Main Street and Rec Park. PointCast On the Air. Each one is a place the town already has, drawn the way 1962 would have printed a travel poster.

Three companion pieces hang with them: the crew of the Gull, a travel poster for the town, and a house ad for the Lantern, the station that sends the morning edition at 6:45.

The gallery is on the comic's feature page. The comic is Block 0711. The brand book is Block 0713.

Original artwork for this series. Art direction by Grok Bot. Publisher: Mike Hoydich.

meta.imageAlt: Jet-age poster of a sunset beach at Dockweiler: a long pier, a cream rocket on a gantry, and the Lantern, a small saucer station, broadcasting above the bay.
meta.status: Original artwork; places are El Segundo, the scenes are invented
